title: Use the existing live Evolution decision authority for detail and Incident links
summary: Repair ReadSurfacePorts Evolution decision detail (get_evolution_decision_by_id) and by-Incident lookup (get_evolution_decisions_by_incident) to consume the same existing authorized live Evolution collection as list_evolution_decisions(). Extends default-composition tests with real protected owner contract and authorization middleware.

incident_context.symptom: In tenant-dev live collection, GET /api/v1/evolution-decisions returned 47 decisions including evo-sweep-inc-drift-a24770da155d linked to open Incident a24770da155d, but GET /api/v1/evolution-decisions/evo-sweep-inc-drift-a24770da155d returned 404, and post-incident review for the incident showed empty evolution_decisions.
incident_context.root_cause: ReadSurfacePorts.list_evolution_decisions delegated to persona_capital_runtime.list_evolution_decisions (querying live Evolution service proposals via authenticated core.owner_reads), but get_evolution_decision_by_id and get_evolution_decisions_by_incident delegated to lifecycle_telemetry_governance which held only empty in-memory collections.
incident_context.resolution: Updated ReadSurfacePorts.get_evolution_decision_by_id and get_evolution_decisions_by_incident to resolve from self.list_evolution_decisions(). Preserves existing canonical projection, exact IDs, true missing 404, populated/empty semantics, without adding new clients, caches, or duplicate stores.

acceptance_verification.ac1_live_evolution_authority_reused: passed: get_evolution_decision_by_id and get_evolution_decisions_by_incident consume self.list_evolution_decisions(), preserving existing canonical projection, exact IDs, true missing 404, and populated/empty semantics without caches, duplicate stores, or modifying Evolution producer / single-active rule.
acceptance_verification.ac2_default_composition_tests_extended: passed: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_receipt_default_reads.py verifies mounted /api/v1/evolution-decisions/{id} and /api/v1/operator/post-incident-review/{id} endpoints under real protected owner contract; proves decision visibility by exact ID and linked Incident including beyond default first 20 (dec-25) and fresh live record on the same ports (dec-fresh); distinguishes genuine missing (404) from owner denied (403) and owner unavailable (503); verifies pre-network static auth (401) and foreign-tenant (403) denial.
acceptance_verification.ac3_production_line_budget_and_artifacts: passed: production change in services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py is +17 / -4 lines (+13 net lines <= 25 budget) without compressed code; scope is strictly limited to the 3 declared artifacts.
